title.zh: 智能合约审计 — Lido（真实语料）

subtitle.en: All 161 smart-contract audits Lido has published since 2020, indexed. Three of them contradict their own numbers.
subtitle.zh: Lido 自 2020 年公开的全部 161 份智能合约审计，做成索引。其中三份的总结和它自己列的数字对不上。

title.en: 161 audit reports between 2020 and 2026, by MixBytes, Statemind, Trail of Bits and others
title.zh: 2020 到 2026 年的 161 份审计，出自 MixBytes、Statemind、Trail of Bits 等

title.en: 31 of the 161 give no issue count, so totals only work for the other 130
title.zh: 161 份里有 31 份没有 issue 数字，总量只能对另外 130 份比较

claims.claim: 31 entries carry no Total Issues line

ev.note: 31 份无法与其余条目做总量对比；含最老的 12-2020 Sigma Prime
lines: 10-2021 Sigma Prime Easy Track Smart Contract Security Assessment
08-2022 MixBytes Lido Protocol Security Auditor's Review

title.en: 98 audits list findings marked 'Acknowledged', meaning accepted and not fixed
title.zh: 98 份审计里带「Acknowledged」的发现，即接受但不修

claims.claim: 98 entries record a concrete number of Acknowledged findings

ev.note: Acknowledged = 团队接受但不修；索引没有字段说明这些后来有没有被修

title.en: The bETH Vault audit says 5 issues. Its own severity list adds to 7, all unfixed.
title.zh: bETH Vault 那份审计写 5 个问题，它自己列的分类加起来是 7 个，全部未修

claims.section: 01-2022 MixBytes bETH Vault Security Audit Report

ev.note: 分类合计 1+4+2 = 7 ≠ 总数 5；且三类全部 Acknowledged，与「3 Fixed」冲突

title.en: The Chainlink CSR audit says 7 issues. Its own severity list adds to 6.
title.zh: Chainlink CSR 那份审计写 7 个问题，它自己列的分类加起来是 6 个

claims.section: 02-2025 Trail of Bits Chainlink CSR Security Review

ev.note: 分类合计 1+2+3 = 6 ≠ 总数 7，少一条未列出的发现

title.en: 'Notes' are counted inside the total in one entry and left out in another
title.zh: 「Notes」在一份里算进总数，在另一份里不算

ev.note: 同一字段名，两条目两种计数口径：一处计入总数，一处不计入
lines: - Total Issues: 9 (4 Risk accepted, 5 Acknowledged)   ← 08-2022 ChainSecurity

q.en: Has anything marked 'Acknowledged' been fixed since?
q.zh: 标为「Acknowledged」的问题后来修过吗？

gaps.a: The index has no field for whether a later audit resolved an earlier finding.

why.en: The index has no field linking an old finding to a later audit.
why.zh: 索引里没有字段把旧发现和后来的审计连起来

q.en: What is inside the 31 audits that report no counts?
q.zh: 没有数字的那 31 份里写了什么？

gaps.a: 31 of 161 entries carry no Total Issues line.

why.en: Totals can only be compared across 130 of 161.
why.zh: 只能对 161 份里的 130 份比总量

q.en: What does each report body say?
q.zh: 每份报告的正文说了什么？

gaps.a: This corpus indexes the README index only; the 161 audit PDFs are not indexed.

why.en: This corpus indexes the README index, not the 161 PDFs. Claims point at README lines.
why.zh: 这个语料索引的是 README，不是 161 份 PDF；结论指向 README 行号
